label: Branch role and lifecycle policy
description: Defines durable, shared, local, and nested branch roles for Eureka Git work.

branch_policy_extension_points.new_durable_channel: add a durable_branch_roles entry with promotion, retention, rollback, and validation rules
branch_policy_extension_points.new_temporary_pattern: add a temporary_branch_roles or nested_branch_policy entry with merge target and cleanup rules
branch_policy_extension_points.new_integration_target: set an explicit target branch in the merge workflow and document whether it promotes to main
branch_policy_extension_points.new_release_flow: add source branch, destination branch, tagging, validation, and rollback requirements before first use

durable_branch_roles.purpose: remote canonical state that every clone can fast-forward from
durable_branch_roles.promotion_rule: validated task or shared branch merges here before work is considered canonical

durable_branch_roles.purpose: future shared integration channel before promotion to main
durable_branch_roles.promotion_rule: future policy must define validation and promotion from dev to main
future policy must define source branch, validation, rollback, and retention

durable_branch_roles.purpose: future long-lived workstream that cannot safely fit one small task branch
durable_branch_roles.promotion_rule: must periodically merge or rebase by explicit policy and must not replace main as canonical truth

temporary_branch_roles.promotion_rule: merge locally into the integration target, validate, push the integration target
publish branch, merge after validation, push integration target, then prune only when contained in the pushed target

nested_branch_policy.merge_order: subtask branches merge into their parent task branch or selected integration target only after validation
nested_branch_policy.cleanup_rule: delete nested branches only after their tip is contained in the pushed parent or integration branch

safe_pruning_rules.required_ancestor_check: branch tip must be contained in the pushed integration target

notes: Main is the only canonical branch today.
Future durable branches such as dev, nightly, alpha, beta, stable, or refactor branches require an explicit branch-role policy update before becoming workflow targets.
Temporary remote task branches are collaboration tools, not permanent records.
